name: research-mapping
description: Read the formal Research Mapping graph and submit a candidate change as a researcher. Reviewing, formalizing, pre-review logs and merged candidates need Owner-or-Centre capabilities and are not on this card.
notes: list_candidates takes a submission_id: a researcher reads the governance record of one submission, not the whole domain candidate queue. list_reviewable_candidates is the Centre Agent's queue and is deliberately absent.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping
tools.description: Read the current formal Research Mapping graph for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping_at_revision
tools.description: Read the exact formal Research Mapping snapshot pinned by a specific formal_revision_id (historical activated revision), using the same consistency gates as the current pointer read. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Read the candidate record associated with a submission. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: submit_candidate
tools.description: Submit a Mapping candidate change set against the exact formal base. Requires candidate_submit or centre capability.
